answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 7663 Country: India Title: Assalamu Alikum 1. Kya mai Bank me Money Deposit Karsaktahu Haj Ke liye ya kisi Jamat ke safar ke liye. Agar Deposit karsakte hai to kaise sood ke Maal ko alag kare. 2. Batcho ka haqeeqa agar 7 din me na kiya ho to kis wakth karna munasib hai ? 3. Arabi Language (speaking in Arabi) sikh ne ke liye asaan tariqa mujhe batai ye ? Jajaakallah Assalamu Alikum Question: Assalamu Alikum 1. Kya mai Bank me Money Deposit Karsaktahu Haj Ke liye ya kisi Jamat ke safar ke liye. Agar Deposit karsakte hai to kaise sood ke Maal ko alag kare. 2. Batcho ka haqeeqa agar 7 din me na kiya ho to kis wakth karna munasib hai ? 3. Arabi Language (speaking in Arabi) sikh ne ke liye asaan tariqa mujhe batai ye ? Jajaakallah Assalamu Alikum Answer ID: 7663 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1788/272=TB/1429) (1) Yes, you can deposit the amount, but you should take out the interest amount given by the bank and give it to the poor without an intention of reward. (2) If it is not possible on seventh day then make it on 14 th day, if it is also not possible then on 21 st day. If not possible, then you can do it any day you like, but it is better to have it on seventh day of birth e.g. the baby was born on Wednesday then the aqiqah should be made on Tuesday. (3) There is a book named: Ham Arabi Kaise Bolain. You can get the book. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
